_note: Copy to config.local.json (untracked) and set each value for your machine. tools/lvconfig.py reads them; LV_<NAME> in the environment overrides any one.
_azerothcore_sql: AzerothCore's base world SQL: quest text, quest givers, creature templates. Any AzerothCore checkout.
_db_reader_cnf: MariaDB defaults file ([client] host, user, password) for a SELECT-only login to your realm's databases: live quest text, the realm's own quests, in-game reports. Keep it outside the repository, mode 600.
_wow_client_data: The 3.3.5a client's Data folder. Voice references and sound effects are extracted from its MPQs (tools/game_voices.py, tools/build_sfx.py); none are kept in this repository.
_war3_archive: Optional: Warcraft III's archive, for characters whose own voice is better there (Thrall).
_comfy_output_dir: The output folder (--output-directory) of the ComfyUI on card 0; this pipeline writes into comfy_subdir inside it. A renderer started by tools/comfy2.sh writes under this repository instead.
_comfyui_dir: A ComfyUI install with TTS Audio Suite (custom_nodes/tts_audio_suite) and its venv; tools/comfy2.sh starts extra instances of it with their own base folders (.comfy2, .comfy3).
_models_dir: Model folder: ASR/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo, ASR/wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft, TTS (IndexTTS-2), classifiers.
_share_dir: Where the nightly run publishes LivingVoices.zip and LivingVoices-update.zip. Empty: not published.
_portal_web: The website folder publish_release.sh installs the help page into. Empty: no website.
_renderers: GPU card -> a ComfyUI with TTS Audio Suite (IndexTTS-2). '1' and '0b' are instances tools/comfy2.sh starts; '0' is any other ComfyUI on card 0.
_llm_url: OpenAI-compatible chat server (llama.cpp's llama-server) running the director/judge model; 8 parallel slots used overnight.
